gaps_found: No dedicated reusable global clean spine audit script.
Canonical state updates are not fully automated.
Legacy and dead scripts remain adjacent to active tooling.
Unrelated unstaged work exists in app/services/velo_prime_service.py.
Chat memory can still be incorrectly treated as context if startup docs are skipped.
Multiple API, pipeline, and training stacks coexist without one documented authority.
Discovery does not codify non_target_count and candidate_collision_count as first-class outputs.
Live loops lack the same artifact freeze discipline as OASIS.
operational_risks: A future agent may accidentally use a legacy or exploratory script instead of the governed path.
A live rerun can write overlapping rows without manifest-like isolation.
Training can be invoked from code paths that are not wired to the current governance gate.
Macro support can lag archive years and silently clamp unless blocked by audit.
Checkpoint branch can be bypassed by dirty working tree usage.
recommended_fixes: Script the global clean spine audit as a reusable mission.
Implement manifest-scoped rollback and residual-row verification.
Automate state file and artifact index refresh at the end of accepted missions.
Create a single training gate controller with mandatory preflight checks.
Treat macro data pack changes as governed releases with audit artifacts.
Quarantine or clearly label alternative API, pipeline, and training stacks.
